### Leadership & Industrial Engineering Philosophy
As an engineering leader in asset-intensive software, I specialize in architecting and delivering distributed industrial digital twin ecosystems that transform raw telemetry from plant DCS, PLC, SCADA, and historians into high-fidelity real-time situational awareness and predictive operations.

- **OT/IT Convergence**: Bridging plant-floor real-time determinism with hyper-scale cloud & edge data pipelines.
- **Organization Scaling**: Mentoring engineering managers, building empowered cross-functional squads, and fostering high-retention engineering cultures.
- **Operational Excellence**: Instilling stringent SRE, chaos testing, IEC 62443 cyber-physical security, and five-nines uptime standards for safety-critical operations.

caseStudies.title: Scalable Hybrid-Edge Digital Twin for Asset Performance Management
caseStudies.summary: End-to-end engineering of a mission-critical digital twin platform synchronizing 120k rotating assets with cloud physics simulation and edge anomaly detection.
caseStudies.situation: The enterprise operated 40+ asset-intensive facilities with legacy, siloed SCADA systems, proprietary historians, and unscheduled downtime costing upwards of $1.8M per incident.
caseStudies.task: As Director of Engineering, chartered to design and deliver a real-time digital twin architecture capable of streaming 2.5M events/sec with sub-second state replication, semantic ontology mapping, and predictive APM.
caseStudies.action: Formed an agile delivery org spanning edge connectivity, streaming ingestion, knowledge graph, and 3D web simulation. Standardized on OPC UA and MQTT Sparkplug B edge collectors with store-and-forward edge caching. Deployed event-driven microservices on Kubernetes using Kafka and distributed time-series databases.
caseStudies.result: Delivered platform to production across 18 major sites within 9 months. Enabled predictive maintenance models that caught 14 critical equipment failures prior to trip, saving an estimated $12M annually.

caseStudies.title: Industrial GenAI Assistant & Real-Time Operational Copilot
caseStudies.summary: Bridging multi-modal engineering documentation (P&ID, manuals, CAD) and live time-series telemetry into an interactive GenAI assistant for control room operators.
caseStudies.situation: Control room operators faced cognitive overload during plant alarms, needing to correlate hundreds of simultaneous alerts against thousands of pages of static P&ID diagrams and SOP binders.
caseStudies.task: Lead the engineering initiative to combine real-time sensor state with vector-indexed engineering data, delivering actionable diagnostic assistance within 5 seconds of alarm firing.
caseStudies.action: Built an agentic RAG pipeline integrating live SCADA alarm events with vector embeddings of plant maintenance records and engineering diagrams. Enforced strict deterministic guardrails to prevent hallucination in safety-critical contexts.
caseStudies.result: Cut Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) by 45% during pilot deployment across two stamping and assembly plants, resulting in zero false triage escalations.

leadershipPrinciples.title: Bridge the Shop Floor to Cloud Reality
leadershipPrinciples.description: Never design software in an ivory tower. Engineers building industrial systems must respect the deterministic reality, safety constraints, and physical friction of plant machinery.
leadershipPrinciples.example: Mandated field rotations for platform tech leads at customer refineries, directly revealing edge network latency pitfalls and refining our offline store-and-forward architecture.

leadershipPrinciples.title: Safety & Determinism First, Speed Second
leadershipPrinciples.description: In consumer web, bugs cause minor glitches; in industrial software, improper setpoint actuation or delayed safety telemetry threatens human life and plant integrity.
leadershipPrinciples.example: Institutionalized automated chaos engineering and IEC 62443 cyber-physical attack simulation as mandatory gating criteria before any release enters plant staging.

leadershipPrinciples.title: Empower Autonomous, High-Trust Squads
leadershipPrinciples.description: Scale engineering organizations by delegating outcome ownership rather than dictating tasks. Hire exceptional managers, align on customer mission, and unblock execution.
leadershipPrinciples.example: Restructured a monolithic 40-person group into five decoupled domain squads (Connectivity, Twin Graph, Analytics, UI/3D, Platform), accelerating sprint velocity by 65%.

leadershipPrinciples.title: Measurable Customer ROI as North Star
leadershipPrinciples.description: Industrial buyers do not buy technology stacks; they buy reduced downtime, improved OEE, energy savings, and operator safety. Platform milestones must track real industrial KPIs.
leadershipPrinciples.example: Tied platform sprint OKRs directly to customer metrics (OEE, MTTR, telemetry ingestion latency), aligning dev priorities with enterprise value.
